## User Stories

### Implement Core Cache Service
- **Story:** As a developer, I want to implement a caching service for build steps so that I can store and retrieve build data efficiently
- **Priority:** P1
- **Story Points:** 5
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - [ ] CacheService class is implemented with get/set/delete operations
  - [ ] Integration with RedisClient is complete
  - [ ] Unit tests cover core caching operations
  - [ ] Error handling for cache failures is implemented
  - [ ] Cache operations are properly logged

### Configure Cache TTL Settings
- **Story:** As a developer, I want to implement configurable TTL settings for cached data so that cache entries expire appropriately
- **Priority:** P2
- **Story Points:** 2
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - [ ] CacheConfig model is implemented
  - [ ] TTL settings are configurable per data type
  - [ ] Default TTL values are defined
  - [ ] Configuration can be updated without service restart
  - [ ] TTL settings are documented

### Implement Cache Invalidation
- **Story:** As a developer, I want to implement cache invalidation mechanisms so that I can clear outdated cache entries
- **Priority:** P1
- **Story Points:** 3
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - [ ] Manual cache invalidation endpoint is implemented
  - [ ] Automatic invalidation triggers are defined
  - [ ] Batch invalidation is supported
  - [ ] Invalidation events are logged
  - [ ] API documentation is updated

### Implement Cache Metrics Collection
- **Story:** As a developer, I want to track cache performance metrics so that I can monitor and optimize cache effectiveness
- **Priority:** P2
- **Story Points:** 3
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - [ ] CacheMetricsCollector is implemented
  - [ ] Hit/miss rates are tracked
  - [ ] Response time metrics are collected
  - [ ] Metrics endpoint is implemented
  - [ ] Metrics are integrated with monitoring system

### Performance Testing and Optimization
- **Story:** As a developer, I want to measure and optimize cache performance so that I can ensure the caching layer improves response times
- **Priority:** P1
- **Story Points:** 5
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - [ ] Baseline performance metrics are established
  - [ ] Load testing with cache is performed
  - [ ] Performance improvements are documented
  - [ ] Cache size and memory usage are optimized
  - [ ] Performance test suite is automated


## Non-Functional Requirements
- Performance: API response times < 200ms
- Security: Follow OWASP Top 10 guidelines
- Scalability: Support horizontal scaling
